headline: Fun-size and glassy early, blown out by afternoon.
today: Short-period SSE with sets to nearly 4ft and a dead-calm dawn — that light early window is the move before it goes cross-on. Get there at first light on the incoming; the ENE cross-off by afternoon isn't enough to save the deteriorating conditions. Fish or groveler.

daysToWatch.note: The standout up here: nearly 3ft prime-angle SE with NE cross-off holding all day. Clean and consistent — the best RI day of the week if you're making the drive.
Still 2-3ft on a prime angle but onshore S wind most of the day knocks it down. Fades from here.
